prompt_for_image_ai:
Ultra high definition illustration for a Filipino education app hero. Canvas 2048×2560 portrait. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY PNG — every pixel outside the artwork must be fully transparent. NO white background, NO grey matte, NO floor, NO gradient sky, NO drop shadow oval, NO baked-in checkerboard.

ART STYLE — follow attached reference poster (boy holding book): soft crayon/colored-pencil editorial illustration with stipple grain and warm optimistic energy. This is NOT flat vector and NOT black-outline sticker art. Does NOT follow KursoKo RIASEC style.

CRITICAL RULES:
- NO black outlines anywhere — not on character, not on props, not on tablet
- Skin is ONE solid flat color #E8A87C — no shadows, no highlights, no cheek blush gradient
- Eyes: simple curved lines or small dark ovals — absolutely NO white in eyes, NO sclera, NO eye whites
- Hair: short wavy messy brown #6B4423 matching reference boy hairstyle — soft texture OK on hair only
- Black rectangular eyeglasses, thin frames, gentle joyful smile

UNIFORM — ONLY element with crayon/paper treatment:
Light blue #6BA3D6 short-sleeve polo shirt (collar, 3 buttons, left chest pocket). Shirt must look like a cut-out piece of paper colored with crayon — visible pencil strokes, paper tooth texture, paper-doll clothing feel. Future-ahead symbolism through hand-drawn crayon energy on shirt ONLY.

TABLET — smooth clean digital render, NOT crayon, NOT hand-drawn:
Vertical tablet held at chest. BACK side faces viewer — matte gunmetal #3A3A3A rear panel, small camera dot. Screen hidden toward character body. NO front glass, NO UI.

POSE: waist-up crop — NO legs, NO feet. Three-quarter facing viewer's left. One hand open welcoming gesture.

FLOATING PROPS (soft illustrated, no black outlines, smaller than character): two open books upper-left, two paper airplanes upper-right, yellow pencil, purple graduation cap, small yellow sparkles, optional tiny teal heart. No readable text.

Quality: ultra crisp, high definition, clean transparent alpha edges.
